description: Run SQL or a function on a timer. `schedule` is five cron fields in UTC ("0 3 * * *") or "N seconds" (1 to 59). Give exactly one of `sql` or `function`; `payload` goes with `function`. Jobs run while the project sleeps and every run is logged. Scope: database:write.

name.description: Job name: 1 to 64 lower-case letters, digits, _ or -

organization_id.description: Organization id. Optional: defaults to the token's organization, or the only one you belong to.

project_id.description: Project id. Optional: defaults to the project created or used last in this session, or the only one.

schedule.description: Five cron fields in UTC, or "N seconds"

name: schedule.create
title: Create a schedule
